disposition_reason: Table 01 prints one value per element for eight biscuit and cookie samples from Quetta.

study.design: Market survey of eight biscuit and cookie samples (five brands plus bakery cookies)
study.market: local markets, a superstore and bakeries in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan
study.method: 1 g ground sample digested with HNO3, then HClO4 and H2SO4, made up to 25 mL; ICP-MS (NexION 300Q)
study.qa: Calibration standards and analytical blanks; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Seven of eight arsenic values are printed as negative numbers (blank-corrected below zero); recorded as below LOD with an integrity flag. No LOD is printed.
Text says copper was noticeably higher in sample 5, but Table 01 gives 1.0250 ppm for E4 and 0.0911 ppm for E5; the copper figure (not used for values) shows two high samples.
Titanium is measured and tabulated although not listed in the abstract.
Basis (dry vs as sold) not stated; samples were briefly oven-dried.
